description: This file defines a final class 'SubjectIdReplacementDefinition' that implements the Function interface to extract the first authorization subject's ID from 'DittoHeaders'. It provides a singleton instance and replaces a placeholder with this subject ID, used within the context of authorization header processing.

classes.name: SubjectIdReplacementDefinition
classes.description: A final singleton class implementing Function to extract subject ID from DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SubjectIdReplacementDefinition.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Extracts the first AuthorizationSubject's ID from DittoHeaders, throwing an exception if missing.
